title: I sold the same jacket to two people

hooks.text: I sold the same jacket... to two people.
Crosslisting almost got me banned from Depop.
The fastest way to sell clothes is also the riskiest.

beats.text: I sold the same jacket... to *two* people.
beats.visual: Tiff holds up a jacket, two phones buzzing on the bed beside her, both say SOLD.

beats.text: It was on Depop and Vinted, because more apps means more *buyers*.
beats.visual: Two app boards with the same jacket listing; little buyer heads pop in.
A clock spins; both boards flip to SOLD.

beats.text: One buyer got the jacket. The other got a refund and a *one-star* review.
beats.visual: Two buyers: one happy with the jacket, one angry with a 1-star sign; Tiff sweats.
Tiff at her laptop; a big DELIST button.

beats.text: Every sale means racing through five other apps to take it *down*.
beats.visual: Tiff frantically typing, five boards flashing, timer ticking.
Tiff shrugs with a price tag and a question mark.

beats.text: Now I snap it once, and *pileGo* lists it on six apps.
beats.visual: Tiff snaps the jacket with her phone; a pileGo! board appears; six app boards light up.

beats.text: Prices come from what things *actually sold* for on eBay.
beats.visual: A price tag fills in with a suggested price.

beats.text: When it sells, it comes down *everywhere* else.
beats.visual: One board flips SOLD, the rest drop away together.
Tiff hands the jacket to one happy buyer, smug wink. pileGo! end card.
